entities.name: ʻIzz al-Dīn al-Ḥaddād
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Izz al-Din al-Haddad, also known by his nom de guerre Abu Suhaib, is a Palestinian politician and militant who has served as the leader and commander of the Al-Qassam Brigades since May 2025. He has also served as the fourth Hamas leader in the Gaza Strip since May 2025. He held both positions following the assassination of his predecessor, Mohammed Sinwar. He also co-currently serves as the head of the Gaza Brigade and oversees the northern sector of the Gaza Strip.
